definitions.gloss: potato, taro, yam, tuber, root vegetable
definitions.explanation: A general term for starchy root vegetables. Context usually clarifies which type (さつまいも, じゃがいも, さといも, etc.).

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}では{芋|いも}がたくさん{採|と}れる。
examples.english: A lot of potatoes are harvested in this region.

examples.japanese: {秋|あき}は{芋|いも}が{美味|おい}しい{季節|きせつ}だ。
examples.english: Autumn is the season when potatoes are delicious.

notes:
Also written as イモ in katakana.

COMMON TYPES:
- じゃがいも: potato
- さつまいも: sweet potato
- さといも: taro

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {芋|いも}を{掘|ほ}る: to dig up potatoes
- {芋|いも}{掘|ほ}り: potato digging (activity)
